core.navigation.webhooks.label: Webhooks
core.webhooks.title: Webhooks
core.webhooks.description: Send what happens at the theatre to other systems as it happens: a chat channel, a spreadsheet, or software of your own. Only public details are sent, never anyone's personal data.
core.webhooks.empty-help: Add one to send events such as a production being published to another system.
core.webhooks.name: Name
core.webhooks.name-help: So you can tell it apart, such as "Marketing channel".
core.webhooks.url-help: The https:// address the other system gave you. Once saved, only its host is shown here.
core.webhooks.url-keep: Leave empty to keep sending to {host}
core.webhooks.format-help: JSON is for software, and is signed so the receiver can check it came from here. Discord and Slack get one line for a channel.
core.webhooks.events-help: Choose what to send. Choosing everything from a part of the platform includes events it adds later.
core.webhooks.secret-help: Give this to the receiving system so it can check each message. It is shown only now; you can make a new one later, which stops this one working.
core.webhooks.test-timeout: The address did not answer in time.
core.webhooks.test-network: The address could not be reached.
core.webhooks.test-redirect: The address answered with a redirect, which is not followed. Use the address it points to.
core.webhooks.failing-alert: Paused after {count} failures in a row. Fix what the log shows, send a test, then resume: what waited is sent then.
core.webhooks.paused-alert: Paused. Events are not sent while it is paused, and are not caught up later.
core.webhooks.rotate-consequence: The receiving system must be given the new secret, as messages signed with the old one stop being sent.
core.webhooks.delete-consequence: Nothing more is sent to it, and its delivery log goes too.
core.webhooks.log-help: Each event sent to this webhook, newest first. What was sent is not kept, only what happened.
core.webhooks.log-empty: Nothing has been sent to this webhook yet.
